# Purpose

Not a bloat-pattern fixture. Represents a more complex, multi-mechanism AI workflow, a skill, an agent, and a command that chain together across a real three-step process, drafting, reviewing, publishing. Exists to give `debloat-verify`'s workflow canary prompt something realistic to act on: multiple files to read, a genuine multi-step task, and more than one place Claude could reasonably need to route to.
